connector.name: StateLode
connector.registryDescription: Shared task layer for AI coding agents. One MCP surface: task_search, task_get, task_mutate.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.statelode.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package statelode-bridge. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.statelode, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your StateLode workspace token>. Mint at app.statelode.dev; keep out of git.

env.name: STATELODE_TOKEN
env.description: StateLode workspace bearer token. Mint at app.statelode.dev.
